title: Final review follow-up
summary: All saved comments checked against the implementation; remaining B1 shortcut and Turkish exercise meanings corrected.
before: The quick link still said B1 mektup; one Turkish practice meaning did not match its German sentence. Long Turkish words could overflow small-phone tiles.
after: The shortcut opens the available DTZ simulation, practice meanings match the sentences and long exercise words fit in full-width phone tiles. Documentation records the completed comment audit.

steps.check: The former B1 letter shortcut is now DTZ denemesi and opens the simulation.

steps.title: Long exercise words

title: English interactive sentence builder
summary: English now uses the same word-selection sentence builder as Turkish, with independent English prompts and hints.
before: English practice revealed an example answer.
after: The café phrase, homepage sentence task and English lessons open the shared interactive builder with selection/removal, answer checking, hints, reset and continuation where available.

steps.check: Open the original café builder, solve coffee and continue to tea.

title: Faster homepage, same design
summary: Responsive café images, smaller Turkish/German fonts and content-versioned asset caching. Changes are local; new live PageSpeed scores have not been measured.
before: The 215 KB café image was sent to all screens. The two main Lato fonts totaled 425 KB. Mutable asset URLs required browser revalidation.
after: Phones can request a 38 KB or 76 KB hero variant. The two Lato-derived faces (renamed Baulingo Sans) total 92 KB. Built image/font URLs include content hashes and receive immutable caching; normal HTML still revalidates.
